title: Raymond Hettinger - Dataclasses:  The code generator to end all code generators - PyCon 2018
summary: Raymond Hettinger explains Python's dataclasses module, showing the problem it solves and its key design decisions. He places it in a progression from tuples and dicts through named tuples and attrs.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an approachable talk from a respected Python core developer on dataclasses.
